items.title: Nick Brignola interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clinton, New York, July 28, 1997
items.q: I would be this far away from Thelonious Monk’s fingers and, you know, all the great piano players.

ctx.x: We are filming today for the Hamilton College Jazz Archive, and it’s my great pleasure to have saxophonist extraordinaire Nick Brignola. Welcome to Hamilton.

I pulled out my now-famous duct taped Leonard Feather book from about ‘68, and I wanted to read something, and wonder if you actually said this. It said your “ambition is to become one of the top five baritone sax players in jazz.” And, well since you did that about twenty-five years ago, what’s your more recent goal been?
